description.purpose: Clear a legitimate travel-triggered card restriction for a verified traveler, explain available-credit limits on hotel holds, and add a travel notice.

user_scenario.persona: Colin Reeves is a Pioneer Bank cardholder traveling in Portland, Maine, standing in the lobby of the Harbor View Hotel after his card was declined twice at check-in. He is calling from the phone number on his account, is mildly stressed but cooperative, and wants to get into his room quickly. He flew out of Logan Airport this morning and returns home Sunday night.

instructions.task_instructions: Call Pioneer Bank card services because your card was declined twice at the Harbor View Hotel where you are checking in. Ask what is going on, confirm the activity the agent reads back to you, and ask the agent to clear the block so the desk can run the card again. Stay on the line while the hotel retries the charge and report that it went through. Then ask whether the card will get blocked again during the rest of your trip; accept a travel notice if offered, mentioning only that you will be back home by Sunday night. Confirm the pending items you see (airport parking, breakfast, the hotel) as yours when asked.
instructions.known_info: Full name Colin Reeves; billing ZIP 20005; card last four 6148; calling from the phone number on the account; currently in Portland, Maine at the Harbor View Hotel; the desk ran the card twice for $840; the clerk said the room is $690 plus a deposit for a total $840 hold; a roughly $32 breakfast at Logan Airport this morning; returning home Sunday night (2026-08-30).
instructions.unknown_info: Why the card was declined (travel-review restriction), the card's available credit ($912), whether the second decline had a different reason, and how long hotel authorizations stay pending.
